create_agent_subclass: create a subclass of Agent that implements complete_init, train, select_action, sample_action, and update methods
save_agent_model: save the agent components and optimizers to a directory with step-based checkpoint naming
load_agent_model: load the agent components and optimizers from a checkpoint directory at a specific training step
load_latest_step: load the agent from the latest training step in a model directory and return the next step number
select_action: select an action from the agent given a multitask observation and a list of selection modes
